description: 只读取固定24原月报，保留全部原行/正文和原保存评分，不读取未来收益列；完整程序执行前保存。
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import json,hashlib,re,unicodedata
import pandas as pd,numpy as np
ROOT=Path.cwd();R='reports/research/510300_purchase_adjustment_current_report_cause_review_v1';OUT=ROOT/R
REF=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_purchase_quantity_cause_increment_v1'
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def norm(s):return re.sub(r'\s+','',unicodedata.normalize('NFKC',s))
def save_new(name,o):
 p=OUT/name;assert not p.exists(),'已有输出不覆盖：'+name
 p.write_text(json.dumps(o,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
proto=json.loads((OUT/'protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
for x in proto['parents']+proto['raw_reports']:assert sha(ROOT/x['path'])==x['sha256']
refs=json.loads((REF/'全部132月采购原文绑定.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
byref={r['stat_month']:r for r in refs}
panel=pd.read_parquet(REF/'原公布采购月度字段.parquet').set_index('stat_month')
d=pd.read_parquet(REF/'原八变量与采购两列_原标签不变.parquet')
d['decision_time']=pd.to_datetime(d.decision_time,utc=True)
usecols=['idx','date','n_train','max_label_exit_idx','score','nonlinear_prediction','control_score','control_nonlinear_prediction','added_field_on_actual_path','actual_path_features']
scores=pd.read_csv(REF/'每日采购条件评分.csv',usecols=usecols).sort_values('idx')
assert len(scores)==1212 and scores.idx.is_unique
records=[];table_rows=[];review=[];fulltext=[]
for raw in proto['raw_reports']:
 month=raw['stat_month'];ref=byref[month];p=ROOT/raw['path'];soup=BeautifulSoup(p.read_bytes(),'html.parser')
 yy,mm=month.split('-');label=yy+'年'+str(int(mm))+'月'
 contexts=[]
 for ti,table in enumerate(soup.find_all('table')):
  rows=[[norm(c.get_text()) for c in tr.find_all(['td','th'])] for tr in table.find_all('tr')]
  headers=[r for r in rows[:5] if '生产' in r and '新订单' in r and '原材料库存' in r]
  for header in headers:
   for ri,row in enumerate(rows):
    if row and row[0]==label:
     assert len(row)==len(header),(month,'核心原表列数不一致')
     fields={k:float(row[header.index(k)]) for k in ['生产','新订单','原材料库存','供应商配送时间']}
     assert all(0<=v<=100 for v in fields.values())
     contexts.append({'table_index':ti,'row_index':ri,'header':header,'current_month_row':row,'values':fields})
 assert contexts and len({json.dumps(v['values'],sort_keys=True) for v in contexts})==1,(month,'核心背景字段缺失或复制表冲突')
 core=contexts[0]['values']
 other=[]
 for x in ref['anchors']:
  header=x['header'];row=x['current_month_row']
  assert row[0]==label and '采购量' in header
  extra={k:float(row[header.index(k)]) for k in ['采购量','主要原材料购进价格','出厂价格','产成品库存']}
  other.append(extra)
 assert len({json.dumps(v,sort_keys=True) for v in other})==1
 fields={**core,**other[0]}
 assert fields['新订单']==float(ref['new_orders_same_source'])
 assert fields['采购量']==float(panel.loc[month,'采购量水平'])
 delta=float(panel.loc[month,'采购量月度变化'])
 editor=soup.select('div.TRS_Editor, div.trs_editor, div#Zoom')
 selector='TRS_Editor_or_Zoom' if editor else 'all_body_p_fallback'
 scope=editor[0] if editor else (soup.body or soup)
 copy=BeautifulSoup(str(scope),'html.parser')
 for tag in copy.find_all(['table','script','style','nav']):tag.decompose()
 paragraphs=[];seen=set()
 for tag in copy.find_all('p'):
  txt=tag.get_text('',strip=True)
  if not txt or txt in seen:continue
  seen.add(txt);paragraphs.append(txt)
 assert paragraphs and any('新订单' in t for t in paragraphs),(month,'正文范围未识别，不能称完整正文核对')
 themes=[]
 topics=[]
 for pi,txt in enumerate(paragraphs):
  clean=txt.replace('制造业采购经理指数','制造业PMI').replace('非制造业采购经理指数','非制造业PMI').replace('采购经理指数','PMI')
  if any(w in clean for w in ['采购','购入','买入','备料','备货','囤货','订货']):
   themes.append({'paragraph_index':pi,'text':txt})
  if any(w in clean for w in ['需求','订单','生产','库存','购进价格','出厂价格','成本','交付','配送']):
   topics.append({'paragraph_index':pi,'text':txt})
 avail=pd.Timestamp(ref['available_at'])
 eligible=d[(d['采购统计月']==month)&d.idx.isin(scores.idx)].sort_values('idx')
 assert len(eligible),(month,'本月原评分缺失')
 after_idx=int(eligible.idx.iloc[0]);after=scores[scores.idx==after_idx].iloc[0]
 before=scores[scores.idx<after_idx].iloc[-1];before_idx=int(before.idx)
 assert d.decision_time.iloc[after_idx]>=avail and d.decision_time.iloc[before_idx]<avail
 assert int(after.max_label_exit_idx)<=after_idx and int(before.max_label_exit_idx)<=before_idx
 scorepair={'before_idx':before_idx,'before_date':str(pd.Timestamp(before.date).date()),'before_decision_time':d.decision_time.iloc[before_idx].isoformat(),'before_score':float(before.score),'before_prediction':float(before.nonlinear_prediction),'first_current_month_idx':after_idx,'first_current_month_date':str(pd.Timestamp(after.date).date()),'first_current_month_decision_time':d.decision_time.iloc[after_idx].isoformat(),'first_score':float(after.score),'first_prediction':float(after.nonlinear_prediction),'score_change':float(after.score-before.score),'prediction_change':float(after.nonlinear_prediction-before.nonlinear_prediction),'actual_added_field_on_first_path':bool(after.added_field_on_actual_path),'first_path_features':after.actual_path_features,'score_shift_purchase_causal_effect':'NOT_IDENTIFIED'}
 row={'stat_month':month,'source_url':ref['source_url'],'published_at':ref['published_at'],'available_at':ref['available_at'],'raw_path':ref['raw_path'],'raw_sha256':ref['raw_sha256'],'method_group':ref['method_group'],'current_month_fields':fields,'purchase_change_pp':delta,'purchase_level_vs50':'ABOVE50' if fields['采购量']>50 else 'BELOW50' if fields['采购量']<50 else 'AT50','purchase_change_sign':'UP' if delta>0 else 'DOWN' if delta<0 else 'UNCHANGED','context_anchors':contexts,'other_current_month_anchors':ref['anchors'],'prose_scope':selector,'prose_paragraphs':paragraphs,'purchase_theme_candidates':themes,'generic_context_prose':topics,'score_time_pair':scorepair,'direct_cause_review_status':'PENDING_MANUAL_REVIEW','historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False}
 records.append(row)
 table_rows.append({'统计月':month,'原公布时刻':ref['published_at'],'原可知时间':ref['available_at'],'采购量扩散指数':fields['采购量'],'采购量月变pp':delta,'采购水平与50比较':row['purchase_level_vs50'],'采购月变方向':row['purchase_change_sign'],**fields,'原文采购主题候选段落数':len(themes),'首次当月评分日':scorepair['first_current_month_date'],'之前保存分数':scorepair['before_score'],'首次当月保存分数':scorepair['first_score'],'保存分数变化':scorepair['score_change'],'之前保存预测':scorepair['before_prediction'],'首次当月保存预测':scorepair['first_prediction'],'首次路径实际用采购':scorepair['actual_added_field_on_first_path']})
 review.append({'stat_month':month,'purchase_level':fields['采购量'],'purchase_change_pp':delta,'purchase_theme_paragraphs':themes,'generic_context_prose':topics})
 fulltext.extend(['# '+month,'','原报告：'+ref['source_url'],'','原文范围：'+selector,'']+[str(i)+'．'+t for i,t in enumerate(paragraphs)]+[''])
 assert len(records)<=24
assert [r['stat_month'] for r in records]==proto['expected_stat_months']
save_new('全部24月原字段_正文_时点评分绑定.json',records)
save_new('全部24月采购主题与背景_待人工核对.json',review)
pd.DataFrame(table_rows).to_csv(OUT/'全部24月采购调整与保存评分时点.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
(OUT/'全部24月原正文_逐月.md').write_text('\n'.join(fulltext)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
for x in proto['parents']+proto['raw_reports']:assert sha(ROOT/x['path'])==x['sha256']
print(json.dumps({'原月报':len(records),'当月原行':'全部绑定','原文范围':'全部识别且采购主题完整定位','训练成熟时点':'24对原保存分数均核对','未来收益列':'未读取','新拟合':0,'新账户':0},ensure_ascii=False))
for r in review:
 print(json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False))
